title: From Trump to Fox News to 8chan: the web of white supremacist rhetoric is wide
summary: The fact that so many of Trump’s Facebook advertisements overtly appeal to white nationalism should disgust us. It should also alarm those who run Facebook. How they can go to work each day knowing that they directly profit from the spread of ethnic hatred is beyond me.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Source: https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree/2019/aug/06/trump-seeds-violent-white-nationalism?CMP=share_btn_tw

The fact that so many of Trump’s Facebook advertisements overtly appeal to white nationalism should disgust us. It should also alarm those who run Facebook. How they can go to work each day knowing that they directly profit from the spread of ethnic hatred is beyond me.
